lastCompletedStory.title: Refactor runKahn under the cognitive-complexity budget and drop the rank.ts biome override

nextStoryContext: US-003 removed the per-file 'src/issues/rank.ts' override block from biome.json's overrides array (was at ~lines 204-213, sat between the src/supervisor/review.ts and src/transcript/usage.ts override blocks; every other override was left untouched). Stripping the override surfaced TWO complexity violations, not just the one named in the story title: runKahn (complexity 20) AND buildGraph (complexity 17, not mentioned in the story notes). Both were refactored by extraction. runKahn -> collectZeroInDegreeLayer (loop+filter), sortLayerByWsjf (the WSJF-desc/numericIdSuffix-asc comparator, logic byte-identical to before), drainLayer (push ranked entry + delete from mutableInDegree + decrement successors' in-degree). The nextRank mutable counter was dropped entirely in favor of `rank: ranked.length + 1` computed inline in drainLayer's push (monotonic invariant: ranked only grows via push, so length+1 == the old nextRank++ at every call site) -- this preserves the dense-1-based-rank invariant exactly. buildGraph -> initGraphEntries (single loop, no branching: zero in-degree + empty successors per universe issue) and recordBlockedByEdges (one issue's blockedBy loop: the 3-way isSatisfied OR short-circuit + get-or-create-successor-list branch), both called from buildGraph's existing two top-level loops. rankIssues (the exported entry point) was untouched -- residualIds derivation (Array.from(mutableInDegree.keys()) after runKahn returns) and all other call-site wiring is unchanged. All 24 existing rank.test.ts assertions pass with ZERO edits (behavior lock held). Verification method for the actual complexity score before writing helpers: temporarily jq-strip the rank.ts override block from biome.json into a scratch file, run `bunx biome lint src/issues/rank.ts` against it, restore the original biome.json -- do this BEFORE assuming the story-title-named function is the only offender in a file covered by a whole-file override. No stories remain in prd.json with passes:false and requires!=operator as of this write; the next implementer should re-run the jq priority query fresh in case new stories were filed since this handoff was written, and if none remain, emit PRD_COMPLETE immediately without touching files.
